; Smart Remarkable answer-here and agent selection-menu buttons.
; Exact target: Ferrari firmware 3.28.0.166.
; No credentials, file I/O, network I/O, native ABI calls, or Draw action.

VERSION 3.28.0.166

AFFECT /qml/common/SceneSelectionHandler.qml
    TRAVERSE Item#selectionRoot
        LOCATE BEFORE SelectionContextualMenu#tools
        INSERT {
            // Exact DeviceSceneView bindings; no parent-chain discovery.
            property string smartRemarkableDocumentId: ""
            property string smartRemarkablePageId: ""
            property int smartRemarkablePageIndex: -1
        }

        TRAVERSE SelectionContextualMenu#tools
            LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button#selectionDuplicate
            INSERT {
                ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                    id: smartRemarkableLlmButton
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    type: tools.type
                    // One pending snapshot shared by both buttons prevents a
                    // rapid answer-here + agent double tap from creating two
                    // requests. The root-only launcher binds this snapshot to
                    // a kernel-random nonce; QML never invents security tokens.
                    property string pendingMode: ""
                    property string pendingSnapshot: ""
                    property bool pendingPrepared: false
                    property var appLoadHelper: null
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/notebook_sparkles"
                    selected: pendingMode === "write_back"

                    // The stock file already derives SelectionPreview.tinted,
                    // border visibility, and menu visibility from
                    // controlsAreVisible. Override only that stock-owned flag:
                    // the selected strokes/images remain rendered while tint
                    // and chrome disappear, and the original binding/value is
                    // restored on every failure.
                    Binding {
                        target: selectionRoot
                        property: "controlsAreVisible"
                        value: false
                        when: smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingPrepared
                        restoreMode: Binding.RestoreBindingOrValue
                    }

                    Connections {
                        target: selectionRoot
                        function onVisibleChanged() {
                            smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                            if (selectionRoot.visible) {
                                // Compile/import the AppLoad helper while the
                                // menu is already visible, before the user can
                                // tap either action. Keep one parent-owned
                                // helper for descriptor and acknowledgement
                                // launches instead of recompiling each phase.
                                Qt.callLater(function() {
                                    if (selectionRoot.visible) {
                                        smartRemarkableLlmButton.ensureAppLoadHelper()
                                    }
                                })
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // The direct AppLoad library call reports only whether the
                    // small launcher process started. If startup or
                    // pre-acceptance transport fails, keep the selection
                    // visible but release the UI guard after a bounded interval
                    // so the same lasso can be retried.
                    Timer {
                        id: smartRemarkablePendingReset
                        interval: 45000
                        repeat: false
                        onTriggered: smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                    }

                    // Phase one: immediately before capture, re-read the live
                    // stock selection and hide its chrome only if geometry,
                    // kind, and orientation still equal the tapped snapshot.
                    Shortcut {
                        enabled: smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingMode !== "" &&
                            !smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingPrepared &&
                            selectionRoot.visible
                        sequence: "Ctrl+Alt+Shift+8"
                        onActivated: {
                            var snapshot = smartRemarkableLlmButton.captureSnapshot()
                            if (snapshot === "" || snapshot !==
                                    smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingSnapshot) {
                                smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                                return
                            }
                            smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingPrepared = true
                            Qt.callLater(function() {
                                if (!smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingPrepared ||
                                        !selectionRoot.visible ||
                                        smartRemarkableLlmButton.captureSnapshot() !==
                                            snapshot ||
                                        selectionRoot.controlsAreVisible !== false ||
                                        !smartRemarkableLlmButton.launchArgument(
                                            "--selection-prepare-ack=" + snapshot)) {
                                    smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                                }
                            })
                        }
                    }

                    // A local capture/validation failure restores the prepared
                    // selection without closing it. This shortcut is disabled
                    // once close() has hidden the handler.
                    Shortcut {
                        enabled: smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingMode !== "" &&
                            smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingPrepared &&
                            selectionRoot.visible
                        sequence: "Ctrl+Alt+Shift+7"
                        onActivated: smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                    }

                    // Phase two: after the immutable crop exists, revalidate
                    // the same live selection again and call the exact stock
                    // close() path. AppLoad publishes an acknowledgement only
                    // after the handler is no longer visible.
                    Shortcut {
                        enabled: smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingMode !== "" &&
                            smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingPrepared &&
                            selectionRoot.visible
                        sequence: "Ctrl+Alt+Shift+9"
                        onActivated: {
                            var snapshot = smartRemarkableLlmButton.captureSnapshot()
                            if (snapshot === "" || snapshot !==
                                    smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingSnapshot) {
                                smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                                return
                            }
                            selectionRoot.close()
                            Qt.callLater(function() {
                                if (!selectionRoot.visible) {
                                    smartRemarkableLlmButton.launchArgument(
                                        "--selection-close-ack=" + snapshot)
                                } else {
                                    smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                                }
                            })
                        }
                    }

                    function clearPendingMode() {
                        smartRemarkablePendingReset.stop()
                        pendingPrepared = false
                        pendingSnapshot = ""
                        pendingMode = ""
                    }

                    function requestMode(mode) {
                        console.log("SR_WAND stage=click")
                        if (pendingMode !== "") {
                            console.warn("SR_WAND stage=pending-rejected")
                            return
                        }
                        if (mode !== "write_back" &&
                                mode !== "whatsapp_only") {
                            console.warn("SR_WAND stage=mode-rejected")
                            return
                        }
                        var snapshot = captureSnapshot()
                        if (snapshot === "") {
                            console.warn("SR_WAND stage=snapshot-rejected")
                            return
                        }
                        var descriptor = "v3," + mode + "," +
                            snapshot.substring(3) + "," +
                            Math.floor(Date.now())
                        pendingMode = mode
                        pendingSnapshot = snapshot
                        pendingPrepared = false
                        smartRemarkablePendingReset.restart()
                        // Let the stock selected state paint before AppLoad's
                        // synchronous process-start check. Revalidate the exact
                        // pending snapshot in case the stock menu changed in
                        // the intervening event-loop turn.
                        Qt.callLater(function() {
                            console.log("SR_WAND stage=deferred-enter")
                            if (pendingMode !== mode ||
                                    pendingSnapshot !== snapshot) {
                                console.warn(
                                    "SR_WAND stage=deferred-pending-rejected")
                                clearPendingMode()
                                return
                            }
                            if (!selectionRoot.visible) {
                                console.warn(
                                    "SR_WAND stage=deferred-hidden-rejected")
                                clearPendingMode()
                                return
                            }
                            if (captureSnapshot() !== snapshot) {
                                console.warn(
                                    "SR_WAND stage=deferred-snapshot-rejected")
                                clearPendingMode()
                                return
                            }
                            if (!launchArgument(
                                    "--selection-button-descriptor=" +
                                    descriptor)) {
                                console.warn(
                                    "SR_WAND stage=launch-rejected")
                                clearPendingMode()
                            }
                        })
                    }

                    function captureSnapshot() {
                        if (!controller || selectionRoot.width <= 0 ||
                                selectionRoot.height <= 0) {
                            return ""
                        }

                        var hasStroke =
                            controller.selectionContainsStroke === true
                        var hasImage =
                            controller.selectionContainsImage === true
                        var kind = ""
                        if (hasStroke && hasImage) {
                            kind = "mixed"
                        } else if (hasStroke) {
                            kind = "ink"
                        } else if (hasImage) {
                            kind = "image"
                        } else {
                            // Unknown/empty stock selections are not sent and
                            // never fall back to framebuffer color detection.
                            return ""
                        }

                        // Bind the descriptor to the stable transform from this
                        // view into the physical scene. Fail closed for a 90°,
                        // mirrored, sheared, or otherwise unknown transform.
                        var rootOrigin = selectionRoot.mapToGlobal(0, 0)
                        var rootX = selectionRoot.mapToGlobal(
                            selectionRoot.width, 0)
                        var rootY = selectionRoot.mapToGlobal(
                            0, selectionRoot.height)
                        var xDx = rootX.x - rootOrigin.x
                        var xDy = rootX.y - rootOrigin.y
                        var yDx = rootY.x - rootOrigin.x
                        var yDy = rootY.y - rootOrigin.y
                        // mapToGlobal may round a genuinely axis-aligned point
                        // by a fraction of one logical pixel. Permit only that
                        // bounded noise: a modest rotation or shear must not
                        // be mislabelled as normal/rot180. The two finite,
                        // positive axis scales must also describe one uniform
                        // scene transform rather than an unknown distortion.
                        var offAxisTolerance = 0.5
                        var xScale = Math.abs(xDx) / selectionRoot.width
                        var yScale = Math.abs(yDy) / selectionRoot.height
                        var scaleTolerance = Math.max(
                            0.001, Math.max(xScale, yScale) * 0.001)
                        if (!isFinite(xDx) || !isFinite(xDy) ||
                                !isFinite(yDx) || !isFinite(yDy) ||
                                !isFinite(xScale) || !isFinite(yScale) ||
                                xScale <= 0 || yScale <= 0 ||
                                Math.abs(xDy) > offAxisTolerance ||
                                Math.abs(yDx) > offAxisTolerance ||
                                Math.abs(xScale - yScale) >
                                    scaleTolerance) {
                            return ""
                        }
                        var orientation = ""
                        if (xDx > 0 && yDy > 0) {
                            orientation = "normal"
                        } else if (xDx < 0 && yDy < 0) {
                            orientation = "rot180"
                        } else {
                            return ""
                        }

                        // Map all four selection corners into the full logical
                        // view and transmit axis-aligned fixed-point bounds.
                        var p0 = selection.mapToItem(selectionRoot, 0, 0)
                        var p1 = selection.mapToItem(
                            selectionRoot, selection.width, 0)
                        var p2 = selection.mapToItem(
                            selectionRoot, 0, selection.height)
                        var p3 = selection.mapToItem(
                            selectionRoot, selection.width, selection.height)
                        var minX = Math.min(p0.x, p1.x, p2.x, p3.x)
                        var minY = Math.min(p0.y, p1.y, p2.y, p3.y)
                        var maxX = Math.max(p0.x, p1.x, p2.x, p3.x)
                        var maxY = Math.max(p0.y, p1.y, p2.y, p3.y)
                        if (!isFinite(minX) || !isFinite(minY) ||
                                !isFinite(maxX) || !isFinite(maxY) ||
                                minX < 0 || minY < 0 ||
                                maxX > selectionRoot.width ||
                                maxY > selectionRoot.height ||
                                maxX <= minX || maxY <= minY) {
                            return ""
                        }

                        var scale = 1000000
                        var x0 = Math.round(
                            minX * scale / selectionRoot.width)
                        var y0 = Math.round(
                            minY * scale / selectionRoot.height)
                        var x1 = Math.round(
                            maxX * scale / selectionRoot.width)
                        var y1 = Math.round(
                            maxY * scale / selectionRoot.height)
                        if (x0 < 0 || y0 < 0 || x1 > scale ||
                                y1 > scale || x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) {
                            return ""
                        }

                        // Device/page identity and visible page geometry are
                        // explicit firmware-pinned bindings supplied by
                        // DeviceSceneView. Arbitrary parent walking and title
                        // inference are intentionally forbidden.
                        var documentId = String(
                            selectionRoot.smartRemarkableDocumentId)
                        var pageId = String(
                            selectionRoot.smartRemarkablePageId)
                        var pageIndex =
                            selectionRoot.smartRemarkablePageIndex
                        if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(
                                    documentId) ||
                                !/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$/.test(
                                    pageId) ||
                                !isFinite(pageIndex) ||
                                Math.floor(pageIndex) !== pageIndex ||
                                pageIndex < 0 || pageIndex > 1000000) {
                            return ""
                        }
                        var pageIdHex = ""
                        for (var pageIdIndex = 0;
                                pageIdIndex < pageId.length;
                                pageIdIndex++) {
                            var byteHex = pageId.charCodeAt(
                                pageIdIndex).toString(16)
                            if (byteHex.length !== 2) {
                                return ""
                            }
                            pageIdHex += byteHex
                        }

                        var pageRect = selectionRoot.pageBounds
                        if (!pageRect || !isFinite(pageRect.x) ||
                                !isFinite(pageRect.y) ||
                                !isFinite(pageRect.width) ||
                                !isFinite(pageRect.height) ||
                                pageRect.width <= 0 ||
                                pageRect.height <= 0) {
                            return ""
                        }
                        var pageLeft = Math.max(0, pageRect.x)
                        var pageTop = Math.max(0, pageRect.y)
                        var pageRight = Math.min(selectionRoot.width,
                            pageRect.x + pageRect.width)
                        var pageBottom = Math.min(selectionRoot.height,
                            pageRect.y + pageRect.height)
                        if (pageRight <= pageLeft ||
                                pageBottom <= pageTop) {
                            return ""
                        }
                        var pageX0 = Math.floor(
                            pageLeft * scale / selectionRoot.width)
                        var pageY0 = Math.floor(
                            pageTop * scale / selectionRoot.height)
                        var pageX1 = Math.ceil(
                            pageRight * scale / selectionRoot.width)
                        var pageY1 = Math.ceil(
                            pageBottom * scale / selectionRoot.height)
                        if (pageX0 < 0 || pageY0 < 0 ||
                                pageX1 > scale || pageY1 > scale ||
                                pageX1 <= pageX0 || pageY1 <= pageY0) {
                            return ""
                        }
                        var pageCompleteness =
                            pageRect.x >= 0 && pageRect.y >= 0 &&
                            pageRect.x + pageRect.width <=
                                selectionRoot.width &&
                            pageRect.y + pageRect.height <=
                                selectionRoot.height ?
                                "full_page" : "viewport_only"

                        return "v3," + kind + "," + orientation + "," +
                            x0 + "," + y0 + "," + x1 + "," + y1 + "," +
                            documentId + "," + pageIdHex + "," +
                            pageIndex + "," + pageX0 + "," + pageY0 + "," +
                            pageX1 + "," + pageY1 + "," +
                            pageCompleteness
                    }

                    function ensureAppLoadHelper() {
                        // Resolve AppLoad dynamically after the stock selection
                        // appears. Keeping the module out of the host file's
                        // static imports lets the stock selection component
                        // keep loading if AppLoad is ever absent or disabled.
                        // Call AppLoadLibrary directly:
                        // AppLoadLauncher broadcasts to every loaded AppLoad
                        // view, and its non-QTFB receiver also dereferences an
                        // undefined window after spawning the process. A
                        // direct library call creates exactly one process and
                        // returns its PID without entering that window path.
                        if (appLoadHelper) {
                            return appLoadHelper
                        }
                        try {
                            appLoadHelper = Qt.createQmlObject(
                                'import QtQuick;\n' +
                                'import net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0;\n' +
                                'AppLoadLibrary { function go(argument) { return launchExternal("external::smart-remarkable", -1, [argument], ({})) } }',
                                selectionRoot,
                                "smart_remarkable_appload_launcher"
                            )
                            if (appLoadHelper) {
                                console.log(
                                    "Smart Remarkable launcher helper ready")
                            }
                        } catch (error) {
                            console.warn("Smart Remarkable launcher unavailable")
                            if (appLoadHelper) {
                                appLoadHelper.destroy()
                                appLoadHelper = null
                            }
                        }
                        return appLoadHelper
                    }

                    function launchArgument(argument) {
                        var helper = ensureAppLoadHelper()
                        if (!helper) {
                            return false
                        }
                        try {
                            var startedAt = Date.now()
                            var pid = helper.go(argument)
                            console.log(
                                "Smart Remarkable launcher process start " +
                                "pid=" + pid + " elapsed_ms=" +
                                (Date.now() - startedAt))
                            if (pid > 0) {
                                return true
                            }
                            console.warn(
                                "Smart Remarkable launcher did not start")
                        } catch (error) {
                            console.warn("Smart Remarkable launcher unavailable")
                            helper.destroy()
                            appLoadHelper = null
                        }
                        return false
                    }

                    onClicked: requestMode("write_back")
                }

                ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                    id: smartRemarkableSendButton
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    type: tools.type
                    iconSource: "qrc:/icons/sparkles.svg"
                    selected: smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingMode === "whatsapp_only"

                    onClicked: smartRemarkableLlmButton.requestMode(
                        "whatsapp_only")
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        TRAVERSE Component#selectionHandlerComponent
            TRAVERSE SceneSelectionHandler#selectionHandler
                LOCATE AFTER ALL
                INSERT {
                    function smartRemarkableBoundDocumentId() {
                        if (!root.document ||
                                root.document.id === undefined ||
                                root.document.id === null) {
                            return ""
                        }
                        return String(root.document.id)
                    }

                    function smartRemarkableBoundPageId() {
                        if (root.pageId === undefined ||
                                root.pageId === null) {
                            return ""
                        }
                        return String(root.pageId)
                    }

                    function smartRemarkableBoundPageIndex() {
                        return typeof root.page === "number" ?
                            root.page : -1
                    }

                    pageBounds: root.pageBorderRect
                    smartRemarkableDocumentId:
                        smartRemarkableBoundDocumentId()
                    smartRemarkablePageId: smartRemarkableBoundPageId()
                    smartRemarkablePageIndex:
                        smartRemarkableBoundPageIndex()
                }
            END TRAVERSE
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
